plain_english: When you learn to eat simply, don't brag about it. If you drink water instead of wine, don't announce it every chance you get. Remember that poor people live with much less than you do, and they handle hardship better. If you want to train yourself to be tough through exercise and going without things, do it for yourself, not to show off. Don't try anything extreme. When you're really thirsty, just rinse your mouth with water and don't tell anyone about it.
original_excerpt: When you have learned to nourish your body frugally, do not pique yourself upon it; nor, if you drink water, be saying upon every occasion, “I drink water.” But first consider how much more frugal are the poor than we, and how much more patient of hardship. If at any time you would inure yourself by exercise to labor and privation, for your own sake and not for the public, do not attempt great feats; but when you are violently thirsty, just rinse your mouth with water, and tell nobody.
